In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
electronic contract in e-commerce transactions using bitcoin is not legally valid because it is difficult to fulfill the terms of validity of Article 1321 of the Civil Code of Indonesia.
electronic contracts in e-commerce transactions using the bitcoin payment method are valid if the parties involved fulfill the provisions of KUH Perdarta in Article 1321 and 1320.

electronic contracts in e-commerce transactions using Bitcoin payment methods must comply with the provisions of Article1320 KUHP, namely: (1) the contract must have an object; (2) the object must be clear, certain and possible; (3) the contract must be made in writing; (4) the contract must not be contrary to law, morality and public order; (5) there is no coercion, deception or fraud.
